research_principle: Old results inform design only; no inherited effect target, rule/threshold tuning, outcome-based exclusions or best-run selection.
primary_selection: Exact frozen P2 primary_representative rows in paired_244; no outcome-based filtering.
repeat_selection: All 137 P2 paired_repeat_observation rows; Full244 only; compare with preselected same exact manufacturer/model/release primary. Report same-installation separately, no physical identity or stability inference.
other_views: App-only 654, partial 11 and same-session extras 6 remain in data/QC accounting, outside paired_244 primary comparison.
reserved_release: After focused tests and complete code/rule/protocol freeze, one P6-specific release; preserve historical P2 lock and P3 guard. Do not change rules based on reserved outcomes.

exposure_disclosure.reserved_role: Prospectively reserved after global QC; not never-seen external blind test.

source_semantics: official lane retains 14 empirically screened semantic entries; support contains deployment/context/collector checks. Report shared evidence families; never independent votes or pure-official causal effects.
no_cross_definition: Remove every active rule requiring both app.* and browser.* fields, including Native-to-Browser; keep remaining predicates unchanged.

metric_definitions.not_applicable: NOT_APPLICABLE, separate and never a positive vote
metric_definitions.relation_deviation: COUNTEREXAMPLE excluding collector_derived_consistency; not attack or false positive
metric_definitions.means: Average across representatives within P2 leakage group, then across groups. Failures remain counted and suppress aggregate means/intervals rather than becoming negatives.
metric_definitions.no_applicable_rules: NOT_EVALUATED; cannot conclude that input surface is useless.

bootstrap.interpretation: Conditional sampling variability within this convenience cohort; not population generalization, significance testing or detection CI.

stratum_policy: All strata saved; below 10 groups descriptive only. No new model-family rules, exclusions or leave-group-out tuning.
legacy_baseline: Replay original 10 compiled device predicates and 9 compiled official relations unchanged on same MTC representatives; retain ordered, independent and availability-gated modes. P4 v1 is post-P3 repaired runtime, not the original historical engine.

historical_diagnostic.policy: One bounded attempt to read existing selected manifests and sibling raw data; no downloads or new collection. Require original two-state admission AND explicit complete 177-field statuses for current runtime mapping. Incompatible/missing cases close with reasons. No inherited labels or effect-count targets; no fabricated Browser fields; report separately from MTC.

execution_order: discovery, development, reserved; rotate fixed variant order by representative index; one runtime execution per cell, with built-in verifier replay.
failure_policy: Persist failed cells with IDs/reasons, retain full intended denominators, no automatic success-only replacement or silent restart after reserved exposure.
timing_policy: Single sequential offline wall time including evidence, execution, retrieval and verifier; median/p95 descriptive only, no phone-latency or optimal-performance claim.
excluded: No TPR/FPR/F1, calibrated risk, cross-device identity accuracy, synthetic attack effectiveness, new learned rules, or dense/vector/LLM RAG efficacy claims.
